correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 272-facet 30,561-face enumeration, 15,179-pair fully acyclic face-poset Morse matching on 150,688 directed incidences yields 2-connectivity. Independent 10,974 valid elementary simplicial collapses yield a 4D subcomplex. Exact signed Z-chain unit cancellations (2168,1703,366,31 in descending degrees) leave only ranks C0=1,C3=54,C4=21 and every residual differential 0, proving all integral homology groups and torsion-freeness. Proof and reproducible assertion-rich standalone checker included.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Two inspected general perfect-matching-complex papers limit scope to geometrically different graph families. The topological constructions on Q4 in results are different, and no general transfer theorem with this statement was located.

originality.rationale: No reviewed published/result-index statement implies the full integral homology and 2-connectivity of the extendable perfect-matching complex of Q4. Bayer–Jelić Milutinović–Vega classify honeycomb cases, Chandrakar–Singh polygonal line tilings; indexed Q3 matching, planar grid matching and Q4 independence/Rips results concern different complexes. The absence of an indexed hit is not itself novelty proof; unindexed equivalent work remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: A possible equivalent result in an unindexed or inaccessible source would negate originality despite negative searches.
A newer 2026 paper on Möbius/circular ladders was found by abstract but its full text was not accessible; the advertised scope differs from Q4.

value.rationale: Q4 is a canonical 16-vertex binary hypercube/toroidal-square graph, whose extendable perfect-matching complex has 272 maximal facets and dimension 7. Its two nonzero reduced integral homology groups lie in dimensions 3 and 4, and 2-connectivity and integral torsion-freeness are not immediate from matchings or mod-2 counts. The exact natural finite benchmark is substantial even without an all-parameter theorem or homotopy wedge splitting.
